# A solution declaring an extern the invocation never bound is a
# configuration fault through the whole stack: exit 2 before anything
# wet runs, and the message teaches the flag that fixes it. The gate's
# own wording and ordering are solution/host's pins; the relay is
# this one.
[short] skip 'drives the go toolchain'

status 2 sdl run $SDLREPO/examples/pingpong
stderr 'unbound extern natsEndpoint \(substrate\.Endpoint\): pass -extern natsEndpoint=<value>'
! stderr 'running'
! stdout .
